name: genetic-assembly
description: Native Rust NSGA-II local optimization companion

scripts.setup: npm --prefix headless-client ci && npm --prefix adapter-sdk ci && npm --prefix cli ci && npm --prefix examples/reference-adapter ci && npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix visualizations ci && npm --prefix demo ci
scripts.build: cargo build --workspace && npm run headless:build && npm run adapter-sdk:build && npm run cli:build && npm run reference:build && npm run client:build && npm run viz:build && npm run demo:build
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && npm run headless:type-check && npm run adapter-sdk:test && npm run cli:build && npm run reference:test && npm run client:type-check && npm run viz:type-check && npm run viz:test && npm run demo:type-check && npm run test:streams
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix tools/docs run dev
scripts.docs:api: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix tools/docs run generate
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix tools/docs run build
scripts.docs:test: npm run docs:build && npm --prefix tools/docs test
scripts.test:streams: npm run headless:build && npm run client:build && node scripts/test-streams.mjs

author: nikodellic
